catalysts.headline: OneSpan reported Q3 2026 results after market close: revenue $63.9M (+12% YoY), subscription revenue +16% YoY, EPS $0.21 vs $0.19 consensus (beat), ARR $195.5M (+9% YoY). Shares rose approximately 22.9% premarket on 2026-10-30; the regular-session closing move was not independently confirmed this pass.
